system.description:
Range: Self

You create illusory copies of yourself, making it more difficult for creatures to target you.

For 1 minute, you gain 4 illusory copies.

When an enemy hits you with an attack or targets you with a spell, roll 1dX where X is 1 + the number of copies you have remaining.

On a roll of 1, the attack hits or the spell goes through. On any other roll, one of your copies is destroyed instead.

If you use this ability again before all the copies are destroyed, you have 4 copies again.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.AD6Mcyv6YBdyhlhF]{Fox Mirror}
